overview.about: The RBC Canadian Open is Canada's national championship and one of the oldest tournaments in professional golf, dating to 1904. It moves between the country's finest courses and carries deep history, having been won by many of the game's all-time greats.
overview.nextEvent: The next RBC Canadian Open is played at TPC Toronto at Osprey Valley in Caledon, Ontario. As the third-oldest continuously run national open, it holds a special place on the schedule the week before the US Open.
